messages:
incident-bot: Pager — rate_limit_spike detected for tenant Cartwheel (tenant_id=cartwheel-prod). 429s > 5% over last 5m. Paging channel eng-oncall. Alert: tenant_rate_limit_error_high.

mike_oncall: acked, taking it. jumping in to signal-path.

mike_oncall: quick snapshot: request rate for cartwheel-prod jumped from ~120rps -> 1.8k rps over 3m. 429s are coming from our rate-limiter service (rl-service). Retries are amplifying. dashboard: https://redwood/dash/cartwheel/rate_limit_spike (looks noisy).

jenna_sre: thanks. can you paste the query you used for the 429s? also confirm if other tenants affected.

mike_oncall: query: `sum(rate(rl_service_responses{tenant="cartwheel-prod", code="429"}[1m])) by (instance)` shows concentrated on rl-node-{3,4}. Looked at infra — CPU and memory normal. this smells like a bad client spike + aggressive retry backoff missing.

sam_support: Cartwheel support ticket (TKT-4821) reporting errors since 10:02 UTC. customers seeing UI "Service temporarily unavailable".

ops_lead: if bots/clients are hammering, we should silence pager noise for this tenant while we mitigate, otherwise oncall keeps getting paged. Recommend 15m silence for tenant alert, and create a tenant-scoped suppression rather than global silence.

mike_oncall: agree. applying tenant silence for 15m. command:
```
# silence pager for tenant cartwheel-prod
redwood-alerts silence create --alert tenant_rate_limit_error_high --match "tenant=cartwheel-prod" --duration 15m --reason "active mitigation: throttling & client contact"
```

incident-bot: Silence applied — tenant_rate_limit_error_high (match: tenant=cartwheel-prod) for 15m by mike_oncall.

jenna_sre: while silenced, we should tune the rule to avoid repeat noisy pages. current rule fires on 5% 5m window. proposal: change to 3m window + require sustained 2x baseline and add retries-in-flight check. pseudo-rule:
```
- rule: tenant_rate_limit_error_high
  expr: increase(rl_service_429_total{tenant="$tenant"}[3m]) > (label_replace(metric_baseline{tenant="$tenant"}, "baseline", "$1", "value", ".*") * 2)
  for: 3m
  annotations: ...
```
This reduces noise from single short spikes but catches sustained pumps.

mike_oncall: makes sense. i'll push a conservative change: raise the threshold to 8% over 3m and add `retries_in_flight > 50` as an extra condition. applying now to staging rules and then prod.

mike_oncall: pushed alert tweak to prod rule (sha: ab12c3). `redwood-alerts reload prod` done.

jenna_sre: also add a small dashboard tile to the tenant overview showing: 1) 429 rate, 2) successful requests/sec, 3) retries_in_flight, 4) rl-token-bucket fill %. Use 1m granularity so we can catch microbursts. I'll make the dashboard template and assign to mike to copy into tenant dashboard.

lia_pm: what's the customer impact? ETA for full mitigation? we need to update the account team and decide if SLA credit applies.

mike_oncall: impact: ~12% of Cartwheel API requests failed at the peak (10:03-10:06 UTC). retries caused UI errors for ~8% of sessions. mitigation: throttled rl-node-3 to reduce retries, applied client-contact mitigation (support sent recommended backoff header via ticket). after throttling, 429s dropped to baseline in ~6m. ETA: monitoring for 30m, then follow-up postmortem.

ops_lead: assign postmortem owner and actions: owner = jenna_sre. runbook items: (1) add tenant-scoped alert templates, (2) add automated suppression on node-isolation, (3) update client SDK retry guidance with exponential backoff example, (4) add tenant tile to the shared tenant dashboard.

mike_oncall: handing off monitoring to @jenna_sre for the night. i'll update the support ticket with a short summary and mitigation steps.

jenna_sre: taking over. i'll monitor rl-service and will escalate if 429 rate goes above 3% sustained for 5m.

sam_support: thanks — I'll post a customer update: summary + recommended client changes + offer to reopen if they still see issues. ticket updated TKT-4821.

incident-bot: Pager status: resolved (alert condition cleared). last_429_rate: 0.6% at 10:12 UTC. auto-close in 30m pending postmortem.

ops_lead: post-incident follow-ups assigned in tickets: PM/Support sync, add dashboard tile (jenna_sre), alert rule change documented (mike_oncall), client retry guidance PR (lia_pm).

mike_oncall: note for alert tuning log: previous rule too sensitive to single-node retry storms; we need more tenant isolation in our thresholds and an internal guard that looks at node distribution. will add to runbook.

jenna_sre: nightly checklist: verify silence expired, confirm no residual pagers, and validate dashboards. will file postmortem by EOD tomorrow.

sam_support: will follow up with Cartwheel account team and include incident summary + potential credit options.

incident-bot: thread closed (automated).
